classification_scope: Applies to this workload. No server is classified by it.
commissioning_state_evidence: Exact artifact selected 2026-08-13. DS4 runtime is not installed on any host. Capacity gate FAILs for hxs-3 on the supported CUDA path.
purpose: Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages testing for Claude Code-style clients
OpenAI chat and responses cross-client testing
cross-runtime conformance against the HX acceptance contract

model_selection._comment: PHASE A. Every field is required before the capacity gate can compute residency. Arbitrary GGUF support is NOT assumed - the model must be one the installed DS4 revision explicitly supports.
model_selection.supported_by_ds4_revision: reviewed DS4 snapshot (ds4-main); this exact GGUF is named in the snapshot's own release smoke-test instructions
model_selection.selection_rationale: Lower-memory DeepSeek V4 Flash CUDA model. Canonical DS4 candidate for this workstream.
model_selection.record_status: RESEARCH RECORD ONLY - not an acquisition authorization

capacity_gate_result._comment: PHASE B. The gate must be RERUN against the exact selected artifact. verdict_for_model must equal model_selection.identity + quantization, or the result is stale and the gate reopens.

model_acquisition._comment: PHASE C. Populated only after the capacity gate returns PASS and acquisition is separately authorized.
model_acquisition.storage_path_status: PROPOSED - no canonical HX model-storage root exists yet. No download is authorized: the artifact-bound capacity gate FAILs for hxs-3.
model_acquisition.authorization_condition: NONE - acquisition is disabled while this workload is DEFERRED

ds4_runtime._comment: CLI flags must be derived from the installed revision's own --help output, never hardcoded from documentation.

documented_reference_target.source: DS4 snapshot README - download_model.sh ds4f-q2 documented for 96/128 GB RAM machines

server._comment: PHASE F. Localhost first. Network exposure is a separate later gate.
server.network_exposure_gate: PHASE K - requires local validation first, then binds the interface resolved from SERVER-REGISTRY.md

activation.note: Operationalization aborted. No download, install or activation is authorized from this definition.

isolation.service_represents: the DS4 workload, never the host role

runtime_compatibility_evidence._comment: Verified verbatim against the local DS4 source tree, not taken from a plan document.
runtime_compatibility_evidence.source: reviewed DS4 snapshot, governance/operations/Ds4/ds4-main (reference only, never vendored)
constraints: Tensor and routed-expert work is split across an even number of GPUs (--cuda-tensor-parallel).
Tested Flash CUDA topologies: Q2 on four cards (two pipeline stages), Q4 on eight cards (four stages).
'Two cards do not have enough memory for these Flash models.'
CUDA placement reserves memory for graph and KV and 'refuses to start if model layers would spill to the CPU.'
runtime_compatibility_evidence.consequence_for_hxs_3: A 2-GPU CUDA topology cannot host ds4f-q2 on the supported upstream execution path.

mainline_single_gpu.evidence: --ssd-streaming, --ssd-streaming-cache-experts, --ssd-streaming-cold, --ssd-streaming-full-layers, --ssd-streaming-preload-experts present in the reviewed snapshot; QA covers CUDA SSD streaming.

multi_gpu_ssd_streaming.reason: Mainline rejects multi-GPU SSD streaming. The open PR adds functionality absent from mainline and carries significant multi-tier changes. Not placed underneath the initial operational baseline.
multi_gpu_ssd_streaming.if_approved_later: own branch, own test plan, own acceptance decision

full_resident_cuda_tp.reason: 2 x 16 GB (32622 MiB aggregate) cannot hold the ~81 GB Flash model. Upstream states two cards do not have enough memory for these Flash models, and CUDA refuses to start if layers would spill to CPU.

cuda_ssd_streaming_single_gpu.status: DEFERRED - was a commissioning candidate; not pursued
cuda_ssd_streaming_single_gpu.reason: SSD streaming avoids requiring the routed-expert portion to stay resident. Mainline supports it on CUDA and QA tests it.
cuda_ssd_streaming_single_gpu.multi_gpu_evidence: Runtime enforces it: ds4 errors with '--ssd-streaming is not compatible with multi-GPU placement'.

initial_settings.rationale: 8 GB is deliberately conservative against a 16 GB card - leaves room for non-streamed tensors, KV, graph scratch, activations, staging buffers and CUDA runtime overhead. The published single-16 GB result used an 11 GB expert cache.

cuda_ssd_streaming_single_gpu.sweep_rule: Advance one step only after the previous step passes. Do not start by maximising.

storage_gate.note: Under SSD streaming the storage device is in the inference path, not cold storage. Capacity and sustained performance both matter.

requirements.preferred: substantially more than 100 GB free on the fast NVMe filesystem hosting the GGUF

status.reason: Poor fit for the immediate HX local-model objective. Hardware and runtime fit were discovered late in commissioning rather than before implementation.
status.operationalization: DISABLED - no install, download, activation or host configuration is permitted from this definition

host_assignment.note: DS4 is not assigned to any host. Prior hxs-3 candidacy is withdrawn; hxs-3 retains its durable registry role and was never modified.

rollback.boundary: Removed DS4 deployment and operationalization. Preserved the engine-neutral runtime acceptance work.
rollback.hxs_3: Returned to prior state. It was never modified: no SSH, no install, no download, no service, no registry change.
rollback.evidence_preserved: History is not squashed. The capacity and commissioning work is retained because it is what exposed the mismatch.
